---
title: "Typst Math Alt"
format: typst
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    typst-math-alt: true
---

## Accessible maths with alt text

This filter emits `#math.equation(alt: ...)` for maths elements wrapped in a Span or Div carrying an `alt` attribute.
This provides accessible alt text for equations in Typst output.

### Inline maths

The equation [$ E = mc^2 $]{alt="Energy equals mass times the speed of light squared"} is fundamental to physics.

### Display maths

::: {alt="The integral of f of x from zero to one"}

$$
\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx
$$

:::
